cause: Successful first-login session could exist without durable User identity while canonical session API requires user_id:string.
impact: UI/backend could not reliably bind operator identity; canonical session response was impossible for orphan sessions.
fix: Transactionally upsert User during first-login verification, always bind Session.userId, exact session/me response, orphan-session revocation.
prevention: Integration tests assert first-login user binding and exact session response keys.
regression: Workflow 35590124349 all required gates PASS; deploy SKIPPED.
